none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Minimize Φ(x)=sup_{y∈Y} f(x,y) over E. Nonconvex dependence on x is permitted.

problem_class.label: saddle_point
problem_class.details: Nonconvex–μ-strongly-concave minimax optimization with an unconstrained minimization variable and a nonempty closed convex maximization domain Y. Strong concavity holds on all of F.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: The bundled reply contains ∇f(z), exactly for every history and seed; no oracle error or sampling dependence is present.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: Each query at z∈E×F returns the exact value f(z), bundled with its gradient and full Hessian.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Exact full second-order oracle: each bundled call also returns D(∇f)(z) as a continuous linear operator. Queries may lie anywhere in E×F, including outside E×Y.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E and F are finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces, with the Euclidean product norm on E×F.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Globally L-Lipschitz gradient and ρ-Lipschitz Hessian; 0<μ≤L and ρ>0. Public parameters include Y,L,μ,ρ,Δ,B,ε,x0,y0. Initialization satisfies y0∈Y, Φ(x0)−Φ(x)≤Δ for every x, and ‖∇f(x0,y0)‖≤B, with Δ,B≥0. No boundedness of Y is required.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ConstrainedMinimaxSecondOrder.lean: Regularity.gradient_lipschitz, Regularity.hessian_lipschitz, Assumptions.initial_gap, Assumptions.initial_gradient, spec.valid, spec.Public, spec.publicInput.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: Return x∈E with ‖∇Φ(x)‖≤ε, where ε>0. Success additionally requires differentiability of Φ on E.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The gradient-norm criterion holds almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law, within the supplied fixed oracle budget.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: A standard smooth nonconvex–strongly-concave minimax formulation with convex constraints on the maximization variable, exact second-order information, and value-function first-order stationarity.
